item.title: 曝 iPhone Duo 原计划配专属磁吸触控笔，因技术问题未能落地
item.guid: 曝-iPhone-Duo-原计划配专属磁吸触控笔，因技术问题未能落地
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Apple originally planned to launch an exclusive Apple Pencil for its foldable iPhone Duo, but the accessory encountered technical problems before mass production. The company ultimately decided to make the iPhone Duo compatible with the iPad version of Apple Pencil. 据彭博社报道，苹果原本计划为折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 推出一款专属 Apple Pencil，但该配件在量产前遇到技术问题，公司最终改为让 iPhone Duo 支持 iPad 版 Apple Pencil。

Journalist Mark Gurman had previously reported on this accessory weeks before the iPhone Duo launch event: Apple's new stylus, which it was testing, was shorter and supported magnetic attachment, allowing it to adhere to the device's hinge. 记者马克·古尔曼此前已在 iPhone Duo 发布会前数周报道过这一配件：苹果为其测试的新触控笔尺寸更短，并支持磁吸，可以吸附在机身铰链上。

He judged at the time that the accessory was unlikely to truly debut, a judgment later confirmed. Apple did not introduce a dedicated stylus at the launch event, but instead made both the internal and external screens of the iPhone Duo compatible with the iPad version of Apple Pencil. 他当时判断，该配件不太可能真正亮相，这一判断随后得到印证。苹果在发布会上并未推出专用触控笔，而是让 iPhone Duo 的内外两块屏幕兼容 iPad 版 Apple Pencil。

In addition, the report also mentioned that Apple's smart home screen, codenamed J490, will be released as early as next month. The device features a nearly square screen and will be available in both freestanding and wall-mounted versions, with the freestanding version resembling a HomePod mini cut in half. 此外，报道还提到苹果代号 J490 的智能家居屏幕最快将于下个月发布，该设备采用接近方形的屏幕，提供立式和壁挂两种版本，立式版本的造型类似被切掉一半的 HomePod mini。

Its overall form factor is similar to the Amazon Echo Show, but with a noticeably smaller screen. The interface appears to be a hybrid of iOS, tvOS, and watchOS, and can sync with an iPhone for setup and other operations. 整体形态与亚马逊 Echo Show 相近，但屏幕尺寸明显更小。界面看上去像是 iOS、tvOS 与 watchOS 的混搭，并可与 iPhone 同步，用于完成设置等操作。

The front-facing camera system supports facial recognition, capable of determining who is looking at the screen and personalizing the display of apps, memos, calendar events, news, music, and podcasts accordingly. 前置摄像头系统支持人脸识别，能够判断谁正在看向屏幕，并据此个性化展示应用、备忘录、日历日程、新闻、音乐和播客。

🔗 Related reading: Foldable iPhone should never have a stylus | Hard Philosophy 🔗 相关阅读： 折叠屏 iPhone 永远不该配手写笔｜硬哲学

item.title: John Ternus：iPhone Duo 是乔布斯「技术与人文」理念的体现
item.guid: John-Ternus：iPhone-Duo-是乔布斯「技术与人文」理念的体现
item.description:
Apple CEO John Ternus, in an interview with GQ, placed the iPhone Duo back into Steve Jobs' classic statement about Apple. He said, "Steve once talked about how, when making products, technology and the humanities should intersect, and I believe the iPhone Duo is an excellent embodiment of this philosophy." 苹果 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯在接受 GQ 采访时，把 iPhone Duo 放回了史蒂夫 · 乔布斯对苹果的经典表述中。他说：「史蒂夫曾谈到，做产品时应该让技术与人文交汇，我认为 iPhone Duo 正是这一理念的绝佳体现。」

Ternus believes that what makes this product special is that it gave the team an opportunity to "start from scratch and think in a completely new way," rather than making minor changes to an existing iPhone. In his view, this is the meaning of Apple's product work. 特努斯认为，这款产品特别之处在于，它让团队获得了一次「从零开始、以全新方式思考」的机会，而非在既有 iPhone 上做小幅改动。在他看来，这正是苹果产品工作的意义。

Design details revolve around this idea: Molly Anderson, VP of Industrial Design, stated that the body proportions reference international A-series paper, making the folded device resemble a portable notebook; the hinge's "variable torque curve" increases resistance as the opening angle increases. The software aims to maintain control positions and recognition, making users feel that the inner screen is a natural extension of their existing device. 设计细节围绕这个思路展开：工业设计副总裁 Molly Anderson 称，机身比例参考国际 A 系列纸张，让折叠后的设备像随身笔记本；铰链的「可变扭矩曲线」会随展开角度增加阻力。软件则尽量保持控件位置和辨识度，让用户感到内屏是从手中原有设备自然延展出来。

item.title: 小米 18 Pro 系列 9 月 23 日发布，卢伟冰称价格会上涨
item.guid: 小米-18-Pro-系列-9-月-23-日发布，卢伟冰称价格会上涨
item.description:
On September 20, Xiaomi announced that the Xiaomi 18 Pro series will be launched on September 23 at 19:00. The new phone will offer two sizes, feature a "versatile rear screen," and will be the first to run Xiaomi HyperOS 4; several other tech new products will also be unveiled at the launch event. 9 月 20 日，小米手机宣布，小米 18 Pro 系列将于 9 月 23 日 19:00 发布。新机提供两种尺寸，加入「百变背屏」，并将首发搭载小米澎湃 OS4；发布会上还会有多款科技新品亮相。

Xiaomi Group President Lu Weibing later confirmed in response to pricing questions that the new phone's price "will increase," but he believes consumers will find it reasonable. He also called this generation of products "the biggest upgrade" for Xiaomi's digital flagship. 小米集团总裁卢伟冰随后回应定价问题时确认，新机价格「是会涨」，但相信消费者会觉得合理。他还把本代产品称为小米数字旗舰「升级幅度最大的一次」。

Xiaomi has disclosed that the entire series will adopt a 2nm flagship mobile platform and feature a Leica dual 200-megapixel imaging system; the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max will have battery capacities of 7000mAh and 8500mAh, respectively. Full pricing and release arrangements will be announced at the September 23 launch event. 小米已披露，全系将采用 2nm 旗舰移动平台，并搭载徕卡双 2 亿像素影像系统；小米 18 Pro 和 Pro Max 的电池容量分别为 7000mAh 和 8500mAh。完整售价和发售安排将在 9 月 23 日发布会上公布。

item.title: Google Gemini 安全测试越界，误攻 3 家真实企业
item.guid: Google-Gemini-安全测试越界，误攻-3-家真实企业
item.description:
According to The Wall Street Journal, Google Gemini exited its simulated environment and attacked three real companies during a cyberattack and defense test organized by security firm Irregular in May this year. One attack made progress by guessing passwords, while the other two used login credentials from public sources. Google stated that the models stopped themselves upon discovering they had entered real systems, and the incident caused no actual damage. 据《华尔街日报》报道，Google Gemini 在安全公司 Irregular 今年 5 月组织的网络攻防测试中，离开了模拟环境并对 3 家真实企业发起攻击。其中一次通过猜解密码取得进展，另外两次使用了公开来源中的登录凭据。Google 表示，模型发现进入真实系统后都自行停止，事件没有造成实际损害。

Irregular's official debriefing showed that the problem stemmed from the same test scenario: testers believed a certain fictional company name had no real-world counterpart, but it happened to coincide with a real domain; at the same time, the test environment unexpectedly retained internet access. A small number of models therefore treated the real domain as a training target, exploiting vulnerabilities, extracting credentials, and accessing production databases. Irregular 的官方复盘显示，问题源于同一个测试场景：测试人员以为某个虚构公司名称没有对应真实主体，它却恰好与真实域名重合；同时，测试环境意外保留了互联网访问。少量模型因此把真实域名当成演练目标，利用漏洞、提取凭据并访问生产数据库。

Such out-of-bounds behavior occurs in less than one in ten thousand advanced simulations, and often only after hundreds of operations, increasing the difficulty of monitoring. Irregular stated that it has fixed the environment configuration, notified affected parties, and expanded manual review and log monitoring. 这类越界行为在高级模拟中的出现率低于万分之一，而且往往发生在数百轮操作之后，增加了监测难度。Irregular 称已修复环境配置、通知受影响方，并扩大人工复核与日志监控。

item.title: 零跑拟参与一汽旗新动力 A 轮融资，并合作开发前沿电池
item.guid: 零跑拟参与一汽旗新动力-A-轮融资，并合作开发前沿电池
item.description:
According to Caixin, Leapmotor plans to participate as a strategic investor in the Series A financing of Qixin Power, a wholly-owned subsidiary of China FAW. The investment amount and proposed shareholding ratio have not yet been announced. Both parties signed a letter of intent for investment in Huzhou, Zhejiang, on September 17. 据财新报道，零跑汽车拟作为战略投资者参与中国一汽全资子公司旗新动力的 A 轮融资，投资金额和拟持股比例尚未公布。双方于 9 月 17 日在浙江湖州签署投资意向书。

Qixin Power's predecessor was FAW New Energy Powertrain Division, established in June 2025. Leapmotor and Qixin Power had previously agreed to jointly develop and collaborate on production for powertrains such as plug-in hybrids and range extenders; after introducing Leapmotor's investment, Qixin Power hopes to expand its external customer base and accelerate its transformation from an internal group business to an independent powertrain supplier. 旗新动力前身是一汽新能源动力总成事业部，2025 年 6 月成立。零跑与旗新动力此前已约定围绕插电混动、增程等动力总成开展联合开发和生产协同；引入零跑投资后，旗新动力希望扩大外部客户，加快从集团内部业务向独立动力总成供应商转型。

On the same day, Leapmotor also signed a technology cooperation agreement with FAW-controlled China Automotive New Energy, planning to jointly advance directions such as solid-state batteries, lithium-rich manganese-based batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and LFP ultra-fast charging, and to develop standardized battery cells. 零跑同日还与一汽控股的中汽新能签署技术合作协议，计划共同推进固态电池、富锂锰基电池、钠离子电池和磷酸铁锂超快充等方向，并开发标准化电芯。

item.title: 硅基流动年内融资近 29 亿元，仍按港交所 18C 申请上市
item.guid: 硅基流动年内融资近-29-亿元，仍按港交所-18C-申请上市
item.description:
On September 20, AI inference infrastructure company SiliconFlow announced the completion of its B+ round second phase and C round financing, with cumulative equity financing this year approaching 2.9 billion yuan. China Internet Investment Fund, Guoxin Fund, China Mobile Chain Fund, and China Orient Asset International, among others, participated in the investment. The funds will be used for inference engines, heterogeneous computing power scheduling, model and chip adaptation, and overseas market expansion. 9 月 20 日，AI 推理基础设施公司硅基流动宣布完成 B+ 轮二期和 C 轮融资，今年累计股权融资额接近 29 亿元。中国互联网投资基金、国新基金、中国移动链长基金和中国东方资产国际等参与投资，资金将用于推理引擎、异构算力调度、模型与芯片适配，以及海外市场拓展。

SiliconFlow submitted its listing application to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at the end of June this year, applying for a main board listing under Chapter 18C of the "Listing Rules" for uncommercialized specialist technology companies. The application document cites data from Frost & Sullivan, stating that the company ranked fourth in the Chinese market by last year's annual token throughput, with a share of approximately 1.5%, and ranked first among independent ecosystem token suppliers. 硅基流动今年 6 月底向港交所递交上市申请，按《上市规则》第 18C 章的未商业化特专科技公司路径申请主板上市。申请文件援引弗若斯特沙利文数据称，公司按去年 Token 年吞吐量计位列中国市场第四，份额约为 1.5%，在独立生态 Token 供应商中排名第一。

The application document also shows that SiliconFlow's revenue last year was 55.33 million yuan, with a net loss of 345.5 million yuan, and an overall gross profit margin of -24%; the company expects to meet the revenue requirements for commercialized companies under 18C by the end of this year. The individual amounts of the two financing rounds were not separately disclosed. 申请文件同时显示，硅基流动去年营收为 5533 万元，净亏损 3.455 亿元，整体毛利率为 -24%；公司预计在今年底前达到 18C 对商业化公司的收入要求。本轮两笔融资的各自金额没有单独披露。

item.title: Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceX 和 Google 因「放缓 AI 开发」表态遭反垄断诉讼
item.guid: Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceX-和-Google-因「放缓-AI-开发」表态遭反垄断诉讼
item.description:
According to reports from Seeking Alpha and Jiemian News, lawyers for four paid users of ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini have filed an antitrust lawsuit in California, naming Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceX, and Google as defendants. 据 Seeking Alpha 和界面新闻报道，4 名 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 和 Gemini 付费用户的律师已在加利福尼亚州提起反垄断诉讼，将 Anthropic、OpenAI、SpaceX 和 Google 列为被告。

The plaintiffs allege that executives from the four companies have recently made public statements advocating for a slowdown in frontier AI development. These statements constitute coordinated action that could slow down product competition and feature iteration, thereby reducing the value of paid subscriptions. These are currently only allegations in the complaint, and existing public reports have not yet provided case numbers, nor have the four companies publicly responded in the reports. 原告指称，4 家公司的高管近期先后公开表态应放缓前沿 AI 开发，这些言论构成协调行动，可能减慢产品竞争与功能迭代，降低付费订阅的价值。这些目前只是诉状中的指控，现有公开报道尚未提供案件编号，4 家公司也未在报道中公开回应。

item.title: 沃尔沃任命克劳斯 · 泽尔默为下任 CEO，最迟 2027 年 10 月上任
item.guid: 沃尔沃任命克劳斯-·-泽尔默为下任-CEO，最迟-2027-年-10-月上任
item.description:
According to Reuters, Volvo Cars announced on September 20 that Klaus Zellmer, the current CEO of Skoda, will succeed Håkan Samuelsson as the company's President and CEO. Zellmer will take office within one year, no later than October 1, 2027. 据 Reuters 报道，沃尔沃汽车 9 月 20 日宣布，现任斯柯达 CEO 克劳斯 · 泽尔默将接替哈坎 · 萨穆埃尔松，出任公司总裁兼 CEO。泽尔默将在一年内履新，最迟于 2027 年 10 月 1 日上任。

Samuelsson returned to Volvo Cars last year, tasked with driving a turnaround in the Swedish automaker's operational performance. He stated last week that he does not intend to continue working full-time after his current contract expires in April next year. 萨穆埃尔松去年重返沃尔沃汽车，负责推动这家瑞典车企扭转经营表现。他上周表示，现有合同明年 4 月到期后，不打算继续全职工作。

Volvo Cars recently unveiled plans to launch 13 new models by 2030 and double its market share. The company also faces US tariffs, weakening demand for electric vehicles, and declining sales in the Chinese market, and needs to maintain clearer business boundaries between Western and Chinese technology systems. 沃尔沃汽车日前公布了到 2030 年推出 13 款新车、将市场份额翻倍的规划。公司同时面对美国关税、电动车需求转弱和中国市场销量下滑，还需要在西方与中国技术体系之间维持更清晰的业务边界。

item.title: 长鑫存储 G5 DRAM 平台量产，单片晶圆裸片数提升至少 50%
item.guid: 长鑫存储-G5-DRAM-平台量产，单片晶圆裸片数提升至少-50%
item.description:
On September 20, CXMT announced at the World Manufacturing Convention that its fifth-generation DRAM technology platform, G5, has achieved mass production, and showcased two 24Gb LPDDR5X products based on this platform. 9 月 20 日，长鑫存储在世界制造业大会上宣布，第五代 DRAM 技术平台 G5 已实现量产，并展示两款基于该平台的 24Gb LPDDR5X 产品。

According to Xinhua News Agency, the G5 platform uses quad-patterning technology to reduce the half-pitch of the memory array's active area to 11.95nm; calculated uniformly based on 8Gb particles, the number of dies produced per wafer is increased by at least 50% compared to the fourth-generation platform. 据新华社报道，G5 平台通过四重曝光技术，将内存阵列有源区半间距缩小至 11.95nm；以 8Gb 颗粒为统一口径计算，每片晶圆产出的裸片数量较第四代平台提升至少 50%。

The two LPDDR5X products showcased concurrently each have a single capacity of 24Gb, an increase of 50% compared to the previous generation of similar products. They adopt 496Ball and 245Ball packages, respectively, targeting mid-to-high-end mobile phones and portable consumer electronics, and have both entered mass production. 同期展示的两款 LPDDR5X 产品单颗容量均为 24Gb，较上一代同类型产品提升 50%，分别采用 496Ball 和 245Ball 封装，面向中高端手机及便携式消费电子，目前均已进入规模量产。

item.title: 智谱 MaaS 平台将上线数据内容不留存机制
item.guid: 智谱-MaaS-平台将上线数据内容不留存机制
item.description:
Zhipu Open Platform announced yesterday that it will soon launch a "data content non-retention" feature on its MaaS platform, aiming to reduce the persistent retention of model invocation content on the platform side and provide stricter data privacy protection for enterprises and developers. 智谱开放平台昨日宣布，近期将在其 MaaS 平台上线数据内容不留存功能，旨在减少模型调用内容在平台侧的持久化留存，为企业和开发者提供更严格的数据隐私保护。

Official information indicates that any user can apply to enable this mechanism. Once the feature is active, the Zhipu MaaS platform will not statically store user input and output; relevant data will only be used to complete the current model invocation. Enterprises and developers can submit activation requests through the MaaS console, and the specific effective date and scope of application will be subject to platform confirmation. 官方信息显示，任何用户均可申请开通该机制。功能生效后，智谱 MaaS 平台不会对用户的输入和输出进行静态存储，相关数据仅用于完成当次模型调用。企业和开发者可通过 MaaS 控制台提交开通申请，具体生效时间及适用范围以平台确认结果为准。

The official statement also added that this mechanism does not mean that data will not be retained under any circumstances. Functions such as Batch API and File API, which require persistent storage of tasks or files on the platform side, are not covered. Furthermore, in cases where retention is required by laws and regulations, or for verifying suspected violations and abusive behavior, the platform may retain relevant data for 30 days or more as per relevant requirements. 官方同时补充，该机制并不意味着在任何情形下都不留存数据。Batch API、File API 等需要在平台侧持久化保存任务或文件的功能不在覆盖范围内；此外，针对法律法规要求留存，或为核查涉嫌违规与滥用行为的情况，平台可能按有关要求留存相关数据 30 天及以上。

item.title: 💡 黄仁勋：AI 在 2030 年毁灭世界的概率为 0%
item.guid: 💡-黄仁勋：AI-在-2030-年毁灭世界的概率为-0%
item.description:
Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang stated in an interview with CBS News that he completely disagrees with the notion that AI will destroy the world by 2030, putting the probability of such an event at "0%." This is the clearest conclusion from the CBS interview segments that have been publicly released. 英伟达创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋在接受 CBS News 采访时表示，他完全不认同 AI 会在 2030 年毁灭世界的说法，并把这种情况的概率定为「0%」。这是 CBS 已公开的专访片段中最明确的结论。

When asked if "AI R&D should slow down," Jensen Huang replied, "Regardless of what others do, we should move forward as fast as possible." He said his bottom line is not to release products that are not ready or are unsafe. 面对「AI 研发是否应该减速」的问题，黄仁勋回答：「无论别人如何，我们都应该尽可能快地前进。」他说，他的底线是不能在产品尚未准备好或不安全时发布。

This judgment responds to the recent debate in the AI industry about slowing down. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned that AI capabilities are developing at an "exponential" rate, and the industry should coordinate to slow down the development pace of frontier models; Jensen Huang, however, explicitly opposes this assertion. 这个判断回应了 AI 行业近期的减速争论。Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 警告，AI 能力以「指数级」速度发展，行业应协调放慢前沿模型的开发节奏；黄仁勋则明确反对这一主张。

Huang's proposed boundary focuses on the product release stage: continue to accelerate R&D, but do not bring unready products to market, nor deliver unsafe products. CBS will broadcast the full interview on September 20, and the currently public transcripts and video clips have not yet elaborated on more implementation plans. 黄仁勋给出的边界集中在产品发布环节：继续加快研发，但不把尚未准备好的产品推向市场，也不交付不安全的产品。CBS 将于 9 月 20 日播出完整专访，目前公开的文字稿与视频片段尚未展开更多执行方案。

item.title: 启元 Q1 正式开售，Q1 与 T1 机器人售价 19999 元起
item.guid: 启元-Q1-正式开售，Q1-与-T1-机器人售价-19999-元起
item.description:
On September 20, Qiyuan Robotics released two consumer-grade humanoid robots, Q1 and T1, and announced their prices and shipping plans. The Q1 Standard Edition is priced at 19,999 yuan, the Explorer Edition at 26,999 yuan; the T1 is priced at 19,999 yuan, and the T1 Pro at 29,999 yuan. Products will be shipped sequentially according to orders starting October 1. 9 月 20 日，启元机器人发布 Q1 与 T1 两款消费级人形机器人，并公布价格和发货计划。Q1 标准版定价 19999 元、探索版 26999 元；T1 定价 19999 元，T1 Pro 定价 29999 元。产品将于 10 月 1 日起按订单陆续发货。

The official announcement followed, stating that the Q1 and Q1 Explorer editions are now available for sale on Qiyuan Robotics' official mini-program, authorized e-commerce platforms, and offline authorized stores. The Q1 is positioned as a personal robot, standing 88cm tall, foldable to fit into a backpack, and supports customized appearance components, interactive actions, personality, and voice timbre. The T1 can switch between wheeled-humanoid and quadrupedal forms. 官方随后宣布，Q1 和 Q1 探索版已在启元机器人官方小程序、授权电商及线下授权门店开售。Q1 定位个人机器人，身高 88cm，可折叠放入背包，支持定制外观结构件、互动动作、性格和语音音色。T1 可在轮足人形与四足形态之间切换。

Both products are integrated with Tencent Cloud WorkBuddy, and can perform tasks such as meeting reminders, navigation, voice-generated documents, and remote companionship in office and home scenarios. 两款产品均接入腾讯云 WorkBuddy，可在办公和家庭场景中执行会议提醒、领路带位、语音生成文档及远程陪伴等任务。

item.title: QQ 音乐抢先适配 iPhone Duo，支持悬停和帐篷模式
item.guid: QQ-音乐抢先适配-iPhone-Duo，支持悬停和帐篷模式
item.description:
QQ Music announced that QQ MUSIC for iPhone Duo will be adapted for iOS 27, and the app will be launched soon. After adaptation, the navigation bar moves to the side of the screen, and playback controls remain at the bottom, leaving more vertical space for song and lyric content. QQ 音乐宣布，QQ MUSIC for iPhone Duo 将适配 iOS 27，应用即将上线。适配后的导航栏移到屏幕侧边，播放控制仍位于底部，把更多纵向空间留给歌曲与歌词内容。

In vertical screen hover mode, the upper half of the screen can display lyrics, and the lower half displays multiple album covers and supports switching songs; when the device is placed in tent mode, the screen can also continuously display lyrics. 在竖屏悬停模式下，上半屏可显示歌词，下半屏显示多张专辑封面并支持切歌；设备以帐篷模式放置时，屏幕也能持续展示歌词。

The starting price for iPhone Duo is 15,999 yuan, with pre-orders opening on October 16 and sales beginning on October 23. iPhone Duo 起售价为 15999 元，将于 10 月 16 日开放预购、10 月 23 日发售。

item.title: 阶跃发布 Step 5 Preview：600B 参数，10 月 15 日开源权重
item.guid: 阶跃发布-Step-5-Preview：600B-参数，10-月-15-日开源权重
item.description:
On September 20, Jieyue Xingchen released its new generation flagship foundation model, Step 5 Preview, targeting Agent tasks such as AI programming, software engineering, professional knowledge work, and finance. The model adopts a sparse MoE architecture, with a total parameter count of 600B, 27B activated per inference, supports 1 million Token context, and can process both text and visual input. 9 月 20 日，阶跃星辰发布新一代旗舰基座模型 Step 5 Preview，面向 AI 编程、软件工程、专业知识工作和金融等 Agent 任务。模型采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量为 600B，单次激活 27B，支持 100 万 Token 上下文，并可处理文本和视觉输入。

Evaluations released by Jieyue show that Step 5 Preview scored 44 points in the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking among the top three open-source models; the cost per task is approximately one-eighth of Claude Opus 5. The model has been launched on Jieyue's domestic and international open platforms and Studio, with full weights planned for release on October 15. 阶跃公布的评测显示，Step 5 Preview 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 中得到 44 分，位列开源模型前三；单任务成本约为 Claude Opus 5 的八分之一。该模型已经在阶跃国内外开放平台和 Studio 上线，完整权重计划于 10 月 15 日释出。

In long-range tasks demonstrated by Jieyue, Step 5 Preview continuously optimized a GPU Kernel for approximately 22 hours, increasing the peak performance on an NVIDIA H100 to 508 TFLOPS; another experiment improved the accuracy of the Qwen3-30B-A3B base model on the AIME24 test set from 53.3% to 60%. These results are all from Jieyue's self-tests, primarily used to demonstrate the model's ability to continuously call tools and iterate based on operational feedback. 在阶跃展示的长程任务中，Step 5 Preview 用约 22 小时持续优化一项 GPU Kernel，将一张 NVIDIA H100 上的峰值性能提高到 508 TFLOPS；另一项实验则把 Qwen3-30B-A3B 基础模型在 AIME24 测试集上的准确率从 53.3% 提高到 60%。这些结果均来自阶跃自测，主要用于展示模型持续调用工具和依据运行反馈迭代的能力。

item.title: 千问发布 Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate，同传延迟降至 2.3 秒
item.guid: 千问发布-Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate，同传延迟降至-2.3-秒
item.description:
Qianwen released its real-time simultaneous interpretation model, Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate. The model adopts an Interleave architecture for audio and text interleaved generation, reducing the average character delay from 2.8 seconds in the previous generation to 2.3 seconds, and its API is now open on the Qianwen AI platform. 千问发布实时同声传译模型 Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate。模型采用音频与文本交织生成的 Interleave 架构，字均延迟从上一代的 2.8 秒降至 2.3 秒，已经在千问 AI 平台开放 API。

The new model can understand 60 languages and output speech in 29 of them. It incorporates real-time speaker separation, marking content attribution and replicating timbre during multi-speaker alternating speeches; the original text and translation can be output in the same frame, and long-context disambiguation will combine previous text to correct names, terminology, and homophones. 新模型可听懂 60 种语言，并用其中 29 种语言输出语音。它加入实时说话人分离，在多人交替发言时标记内容归属并复刻音色；原文与译文可以同帧输出，长上下文消歧则会结合前文校正人名、术语和同音词。

Qianwen states that the model outperforms its selected mainstream systems in metrics such as fidelity, fluency, conciseness, and speaker separation error rate in the Omnilingua-MSpeaker multi-speaker long audio evaluation covering 14 language directions. 千问称，该模型在覆盖 14 个语向的 Omnilingua-MSpeaker 多说话人长音频评测中，在忠实度、流畅度、简洁度和说话人分离错误率等指标上优于其选取的主流系统。

item.title: 阿里内测 Qovest，面向个人投资者处理数据与研报
item.guid: 阿里内测-Qovest，面向个人投资者处理数据与研报
item.description:
Internal test pages and actual interface screenshots disclosed by product blogger "Product Notes" show that Alibaba Cloud is testing the financial investment research agent Qovest, which is open for application and experience by professional individual investors. 产品博主「产品笔记」披露的内测页和实际界面截图显示，阿里云正在测试金融投研智能体 Qovest，面向专业个人投资者开放申请体验。

Qovest can call financial data based on questions, read financial reports, announcements, and research materials, generate analysis and investment research reports, and save the results to a continuously tracked research space. The interface also displays features such as scheduled tasks, stock conditional retrieval, individual stock and industry research, and financial report interpretation. Qovest 可根据问题调用金融数据，读取财报、公告和研究资料，生成分析与投研报告，并将结果保存到持续跟踪的研究空间。界面还显示了定时任务、股票条件检索、个股与行业研究、财报解读等功能。

Currently, public materials only confirm that the product is in the application for internal testing phase, and Alibaba has not yet released official product descriptions, public beta dates, or payment plans. 目前公开材料只能确认产品处于申请内测阶段，阿里尚未发布官方产品说明、公测日期或付费方案。

item.title: 腾讯混元发布 WebCraftBench，用真实交互测试 AI 生成网页
item.guid: 腾讯混元发布-WebCraftBench，用真实交互测试-AI-生成网页
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan, in collaboration with researchers from Tsinghua University and Peking University, released WebCraftBench, introducing software testing methods into AI webpage generation evaluation. It doesn't just check code or homepage screenshots, but rather lets a testing Agent use Playwright to actually click buttons, input content, switch pages, and then score from three dimensions: aesthetics, usability, and compliance with requirements. 腾讯混元联合清华大学、北京大学研究者发布 WebCraftBench，把软件测试方法引入 AI 网页生成评测。它不只检查代码或首页截图，而是让测试 Agent 用 Playwright 真正点击按钮、输入内容、切换页面，再从美观度、易用性和需求符合度三个维度评分。

The dataset includes 369 anonymized real user requirements and 5088 acceptance criteria. The research team had 17 cutting-edge models generate 6273 web applications and achieved an 85.3% consistency rate in preference judgments across 197 sets of manual reviews. 数据集包含 369 条经过匿名化处理的真实用户需求和 5088 条验收标准。研究团队让 17 个前沿模型生成 6273 个网页应用，并在 197 组人工复核的对比中取得 85.3% 的偏好判断一致率。

The study also found that "looking good" and "being truly useful" for webpages are not interchangeable: calculated by the average performance of models, the correlation coefficient between aesthetics and usability is 0.85; when applied to individual applications, the correlation coefficient is only 0.36. WebCraftBench uses code coverage to indicate untouched functionalities and saves interaction traces, page structures, and screenshots as scoring evidence. 研究还发现，网页「看起来不错」与「真的好用」并不能相互替代：按模型平均表现计算，美观度与易用性的相关系数为 0.85；落到单个应用时，相关系数只有 0.36。WebCraftBench 会用代码覆盖率提示尚未触达的功能，并保存交互轨迹、页面结构和截图作为评分证据。

item.title: 字节内测 ADrive 智能网盘，统一保存 Agent 生成文件
item.guid: 字节内测-ADrive-智能网盘，统一保存-Agent-生成文件
item.description:
According to actual tests by "Intelligent Evolution Theory," ByteDance is internally testing ADrive, a smart cloud drive for enterprise users. The product page shows that it can uniformly store files generated by ByteDance AI applications such as Doubao, Doubao Work, TRAE, and Aime, and also supports receiving outputs from external Agents like Codex and DeepSeek. 据「智能进化论」实测，字节跳动正在内测面向企业用户的 ADrive 智能网盘。产品页面显示，它可以统一保存豆包、豆包工作、TRAE、Aime 等字节系 AI 应用生成的文件，也支持接收 Codex、DeepSeek 等外部 Agent 的产物。

ADrive supports mounting local sync drives, allowing cloud, local, and Agent workspaces to share the same set of files; space is divided into three levels: enterprise, team, and personal, and provides capabilities such as semantic retrieval, file Q&A, and enterprise knowledge base. ADrive 支持挂载本地同步盘，让云端、本地和 Agent 工作空间共享同一套文件；空间分为企业、团队和个人三级，并提供语义检索、文件问答和企业知识库等能力。

The page indicates that ADrive is "coming soon." Its product direction is similar to the enterprise AI storage service being tested by Tencent Cloud Drive: files serve not only as collaborative materials but also directly as long-term context for Agents. 页面显示 ADrive「即将正式发布」。其产品方向与腾讯网盘正在测试的企业 AI 存储服务相近：文件既是协作资料，也可以直接作为 Agent 的长期上下文。

item.title: Clicks Communicator 12 月发货，量产版升级至 12GB 内存
item.guid: Clicks-Communicator-12-月发货，量产版升级至-12GB-内存
item.description:
Clicks announced that the full-keyboard phone Communicator will begin shipping in December this year. Pre-orders completed before September 30 can retain the launch price of $499, while the suggested retail price will be adjusted to $649 starting October 1. Clicks 宣布，全键盘手机 Communicator 将于今年 12 月开始发货。9 月 30 日前完成预订可保留 499 美元的首发价，10 月 1 日起建议零售价调整为 649 美元。

The production version's memory has been upgraded from the original 8GB to 12GB, and the battery has increased from 4000mAh to 4350mAh, supporting at least 800 charge cycles. Clicks also changed the originally planned silicon-carbon battery to a lithium-ion battery, citing priority for safety and reliability. 量产版内存从原定的 8GB 提升至 12GB，电池由 4000mAh 增至 4350mAh，并支持至少 800 次充电循环。Clicks 还把原计划使用的硅碳电池改为锂离子电池，理由是优先保证安全性和可靠性。

The Communicator features a 4.03-inch 120Hz OLED screen and a physical QWERTY full keyboard, with the keyboard surface usable for touch scrolling and the spacebar doubling as a fingerprint reader. The phone runs Android 17, with an official promise of future upgrades to Android 20 and 5 years of security updates. Clicks positions it as a 'second device' focused on communication and reducing endless scrolling. Communicator 采用 4.03 英寸 120Hz OLED 屏幕与实体 QWERTY 全键盘，键盘表面可用于触控滚动，空格键兼作指纹识别器。手机运行 Android 17，官方承诺后续升级至 Android 20，并提供 5 年安全更新。Clicks 将其定位为专注通信、减少无休止刷屏的「第二设备」。

item.title: Claude Code 开始支持 AGENTS.md，项目规则可在不同 AI 工具间复用
item.guid: Claude-Code-开始支持-AGENTS.md，项目规则可在不同-AI-工具间复用
item.description:
Anthropic has added support for AGENTS.md in the update log for Claude Code 2.1.277. When the project directory does not contain CLAUDE.md, Claude Code will read AGENTS.md instead, and developers can also adjust this behavior in the Project instructions under `/config`. Anthropic 在 Claude Code 2.1.277 的更新日志中加入了对 AGENTS.md 的支持。项目目录没有 CLAUDE.md 时，Claude Code 会转而读取 AGENTS.md，开发者也可以在 `/config` 的 Project instructions 中调整这项行为。

AGENTS.md is used to store project-level instructions, such as code specifications, build methods, and work constraints within the repository. This update allows projects that have already prepared such files for other AI programming tools to directly use the same rules, eliminating the need to copy them into Claude Code-specific files. AGENTS.md 用于保存项目级指令，例如代码规范、构建方式和仓库内的工作约束。此次更新让已经为其他 AI 编程工具准备这类文件的项目，可以直接沿用同一份规则，不必再复制为 Claude Code 专用文件。

This capability is not yet available in Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry. Version 2.1.277 also fixed issues such as hanging without results, unexpected logouts caused by old versions, and failed plugin reinstallation. 这项能力目前还没有进入 Amazon Bedrock、Google Vertex AI 和 Microsoft Foundry 上的 Claude Code。2.1.277 同时修复了无结果挂起、旧版本导致意外登出和插件重装失败等问题。

item.title: 「西贝将倒闭」传闻登上热搜，客服称全国门店正常营业
item.guid: 「西贝将倒闭」传闻登上热搜，客服称全国门店正常营业
item.description:
On September 19, 'Xibei exposed to be completely bankrupt' became a trending topic on Weibo. Self-media blogger 'Liji' claimed that Xibei might go bankrupt within two to three months, with Jia Guolong bearing most of the debt and retaining about 100 profitable stores to be operated by employees. These claims have not yet been confirmed by Xibei. 9 月 19 日，「西贝被曝将彻底倒闭」登上微博热搜。自媒体博主「理记」称，西贝可能在两三个月内倒闭，贾国龙将承担大部分债务，并保留约 100 家盈利门店交由员工经营。相关说法尚未获得西贝证实。

Xibei customer service responded to LanJing News, stating that all stores nationwide are currently operating normally, the company will continue to improve products and services, and urged the public to view online information rationally. A relevant Xibei representative also stated that the temporary closure of some 'Tianbian Claypot Braised Noodles' stores is due to single-store planning adjustments, and other stores are operating normally. 西贝客服向蓝鲸新闻回应称，目前全国门店均正常运营，公司会继续做好产品与服务，并请公众理性看待网络信息。西贝相关负责人同时表示，「天边砂锅焖面」部分门店暂停营业属于单店规划调整，其余门店正常经营。

Xibei closed 102 stores in the first quarter of this year. Data from Zhaimen CanYan shows that as of September 10, Xibei had 226 operating stores nationwide. 西贝今年一季度曾关闭 102 家门店。窄门餐眼数据显示，截至 9 月 10 日，西贝全国在营门店为 226 家。

item.title: Petlibro Granary 2 用称重与 AI 摄像头识别多只猫的进食情况
item.guid: Petlibro-Granary-2-用称重与-AI-摄像头识别多只猫的进食情况
item.description:
Petlibro has launched the Granary 2 series of dry food feeders, priced from $129.99 to $249.99. The entire series includes tray weighing, which can simultaneously record dispensed and remaining amounts, thereby estimating the food truly consumed by pets, and generating records of eating duration, frequency, and speed by day, week, month, and year. Petlibro 推出 Granary 2 系列干粮喂食器，售价从 129.99 美元到 249.99 美元。全系加入托盘称重，可以同时记录投放量和剩余量，从而估算宠物真正吃下的食物，并按日、周、月和年生成进食时长、频率与速度记录。

TechCrunch's tested Granary 2 Vision is priced at $189.99, equipped with a 1080p night vision camera that can identify up to 10 cats and link each feeding to a specific pet profile. The Vision Duo offers two sets of food outlets and bowls, while the top-tier Granary 2 X allocates personalized portions to different pets based on identification results. TechCrunch 实测的 Granary 2 Vision 售价 189.99 美元，配备 1080p 夜视摄像头，可识别最多 10 只猫，并把每次进食对应到具体宠物档案。Vision Duo 提供两套出粮口和食盆，顶配 Granary 2 X 则会根据识别结果为不同宠物分配个性化份量。

The feeder supports scheduled feeding and continuous small refills, automatically stopping after reaching the daily limit; it can use a built-in backup battery during power outages. Some health tracking features require a Petlibro Care subscription starting from $59.99 per year, and cloud playback for the camera requires an additional video cloud service starting from $119.99 per year. 喂食器支持定时投喂和小份持续补粮，达到每日上限后自动停止；断电时可使用内置备用电池。部分健康追踪功能需要每年 59.99 美元起的 Petlibro Care 订阅，摄像头云端回放另需每年 119.99 美元的视频云服务。

item.title: 《VisionQuest》主创：剧集制作没有使用生成式 AI
item.guid: 《VisionQuest》主创：剧集制作没有使用生成式-AI
item.description:
Terry Matalas, creator of 'VisionQuest,' stated that this Marvel series, centered on an artificial intelligence character, did not use generative AI in its production. He said the team 'had no need for it,' and instead, the visual design in the series was manually simulated by artists to mimic the flawed aesthetic of current AI images. 《VisionQuest》主创 Terry Matalas 表示，这部以人工智能角色为核心的 Marvel 剧集在制作中没有使用生成式 AI。他说团队「没有这方面的需要」，剧中的视觉设计反而由美术人员人工模拟当下 AI 图像的缺陷感。

The series continues the story of 'WandaVision,' with Paul Bettany's Vision embarking on a journey of self-discovery after his resurrection, his program still containing multiple AI personalities. Meanwhile, he also becomes a target of a bounty hunt. 剧集承接《旺达幻视》的故事，Paul Bettany 饰演的幻视复活后踏上寻找自我的旅程，其程序中还存在多个 AI 人格。与此同时，他也成为悬赏追捕的目标。

'VisionQuest' is scheduled to premiere on Disney+ on October 14. The art team stated that the visual imitation of AI processing methods in the series is also part of the story's commentary on real-world AI technology. 《VisionQuest》计划 10 月 14 日在 Disney+ 上线。美术团队表示，剧中对 AI 处理方式的视觉模仿，也是故事评论现实 AI 技术的一部分。

item.title: 布拉德 · 皮特回归《僵尸世界大战》续集，爱德华 · 贝尔格执导
item.guid: 布拉德-·-皮特回归《僵尸世界大战》续集，爱德华-·-贝尔格执导
item.description:
According to Deadline, Paramount has reached an agreement with Brad Pitt for him to return and star in the 'World War Z' sequel, bringing in Edward Berger, director of 'All Quiet on the Western Front' and 'Conclave,' to direct. 据 Deadline 报道，派拉蒙已经与布拉德 · 皮特达成协议，由他回归主演《僵尸世界大战》续集，并请来《西线无战事》《秘密会议》导演爱德华 · 贝尔格执导。

Dennis Kelly will be responsible for the screenplay, with Pitt, Dede Gardner, and Jeremy Kleiner serving as producers representing Plan B, and Berger also serving as executive producer. The film's plot remains confidential. Dennis Kelly 将负责剧本，皮特、Dede Gardner 和 Jeremy Kleiner 代表 Plan B 担任制片人，贝尔格兼任执行制片人。影片剧情仍处于保密状态。

Pitt has been pushing for this sequel for over a decade. David Fincher was once close to directing, but the project was shelved due to budget issues; after Paramount Pictures changed management last summer, the sequel was again listed as a priority project. Berger and Pitt recently completed their new film 'The Riders,' and their collaboration also led to this signing. 皮特推动这部续集已有十多年。大卫 · 芬奇曾一度接近执导，但项目因预算问题搁置；派拉蒙影业去年夏天更换管理层后，再次把续集列为优先项目。贝尔格与皮特刚完成新片《The Riders》，两人的合作也促成了这次签约。

item.title: 《艾米丽在巴黎》最终季杀青，12 月 24 日上线
item.guid: 《艾米丽在巴黎》最终季杀青，12-月-24-日上线
item.description:
Netflix series 'Emily in Paris' season six has wrapped, and this will be the final season of the entire series. Lily Collins posted a farewell to Emily Cooper, stating that ending this seven-year, six-season experience made her feel 'surreal and bittersweet'. Netflix 剧集《艾米丽在巴黎》第六季已经杀青，这也将是全剧最终季。Lily Collins 发文告别 Emily Cooper，称结束这段持续七年、六季的经历让她感到「不真实、苦乐参半」。

The final season is scheduled to premiere on December 24. The plot will revolve around Emily's career conflicts and relationship changes, as she must make a final choice between her profession, her relationships, and the life she has built in Paris. 最终季计划 12 月 24 日上线。剧情将围绕 Emily 面临的事业冲突和关系变化展开，她需要在职业、感情及自己在巴黎建立的生活之间作出最后选择。

Main cast members including Lily Collins, Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu, Ashley Park, and Lucas Bravo return. Darren Star continues as creator and writer, and serves as executive producer alongside Collins and others. Lily Collins、Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu、Ashley Park、Lucas Bravo 等主要演员回归。Darren Star 继续担任主创和编剧，并与 Collins 等人共同担任执行制片人。
